lines.zh: 我从繁茂洞穴的藤影里飘过。
lines.en: I drift through lush cave vines.
I pass through the trunk and leave no trace.

lines.zh: 红沙上，我的影子更淡了。
lines.en: On the red sand my shadow grows fainter.
I float in the tree shadows, silent.
I drift along the cave ceiling.
The twig you snapped is still cracking.

lines.zh: 我在针叶林里嗅到一个人。
lines.en: I smell a person in the pines.
My gaze settles on the back of your neck.
I keep to the shadows and follow.

lines.zh: 我穿过针叶林，目光已对准你。
lines.en: I drift through the pines, my gaze fixed on you.
The living breath in this wood is mine.
I hang in the air without blinking.

lines.zh: 虚无飘忽的身躯受伤了！
飘忽不定的光影，引诱你靠近
lines.en: Dance of light, draw you near.
Whisper of wraith, ensnare thy soul.
Night calls, into abyss you fall.
Hit by wraith, soul in shock.
Hit by cold, fear in heart.
Hit by light, fear in heart.
Hit by shadow, fear in heart.
Hit by wraith, fear in heart.
Hit by ghost, soul in shock.

lines.zh: 找到了一个遗落的灵魂，

lines.en: Searching for food in the dark.

lines.zh: 我找到了一个新的魂灵，
一个灵魂，可以玩弄一下，
找到一个可以玩的新目标，
林子安静下来，我找到了。
lines.en: The woods go quiet. I have found it.
Your soul-fire flickers between the trees.
Not even the badlands wind can carry me off.
That echo in the cave is you breathing.

lines.zh: 我不需要身体，也能抓住你。
lines.en: I need no body to take hold of you.

lines.zh: 它的目光锁定在你身上，

lines.en: Your soul is about to be taken.
I slide down along the cave roof.
Don't light a fire; it won't scatter me.
Your soul is leaning my way.
I have just one breath left to take.
A pale blue gathers in the tree shadow.
Listen — I breathe at your ear.

lines.zh: 铁刃过去，我连晃都没晃。
lines.en: The blade passes; I do not even waver.
On the sand I count your steps.

lines.zh: 飘过你的身边，带来寒冷的气息。
lines.en: Whispering past you, bringing icy breath.

lines.zh: 追逐着你的影子，寻找猎物。
在你的梦里游荡，寻找下一个目标。
lines.en: Wandering in your dreams, seeking the next target.

lines.zh: 无声的翅膀扇动，无声的攻击。
从黑暗中浮现，准备攻击。
lines.en: Emerging from the darkness, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 在月光下徘徊，寻找猎物。
在夜晚出现，用寒冷击倒你。
lines.en: Appearing at night, chilling you down.

lines.zh: 飘荡在坟墓之间，寻找新的牺牲品。
lines.en: Drifting among graves, seeking new sacrifices.

lines.zh: 无声无息，却致命的打击。
在你背后游荡，静待时机。
lines.en: Wandering behind you, waiting for the chance.

lines.zh: 寒气顺着你的袖子爬上来！

lines.en: My hand passes through your chest.
Your soul is hauled out half an inch!
I laugh, and the wind turns cold.
One touch and your limbs go stiff.

lines.zh: 我绕到你背后，贴得很近。
lines.en: I slip behind you, very close.

lines.zh: 在黑暗中孵化，寒冷而致命。
lines.en: Hatched in darkness, cold and deadly.

lines.zh: 从破旧的棺材中出现，寻找猎物。
lines.en: Emerging from a broken coffin, seeking prey.

lines.zh: 在废弃的村庄中出现，四处寻找。
lines.en: Spawning in abandoned villages, searching everywhere.

lines.zh: 在寒冷的地方孵化，寻找温暖。
lines.en: Hatched in cold places, seeking warmth.

lines.zh: 在针叶林中孵化，寒冷而危险。
lines.en: Hatched in the spruce forest, cold and perilous.

lines.zh: 在繁茂洞穴中孵化，寻找猎物。
lines.en: Hatched in lush caves, seeking prey.

lines.zh: 在恶地中孵化，寻求新的牺牲品。
lines.en: Hatched in the wasteland, seeking new sacrifices.

lines.zh: 在森林中孵化，寻找新的目标。
lines.en: Hatched in the forest, seeking new targets.

lines.zh: 在月光下孵化，准备出击。
lines.en: Hatched in moonlight, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 在坟墓附近孵化，准备袭击。
lines.en: Hatched near graves, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 恶地的热风里，我浮起来。
lines.en: In the badlands' hot wind I float up.
A thread of blue hangs down among the conifers.
Deep in the cave, I open my eyes.
Someone just lit a fire by the grave.

lines.zh: 我连水都不该碰，却沉了。
lines.en: I should not touch water, yet I sank.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的蓝光震散了。
lines.en: The blast scattered my blue glow.

lines.zh: 箭穿过去，我身上多了个洞。
lines.en: The arrow went through and left a hole in me.
Even a ghost fears spells — how embarrassing.
Lightning passed through me — I'm fading.
Black water pours into my shadow!
